current_source_capture.positive_record_semantics: A typed source record supports recorded administration during ICU hours 0-24.

required_source_coverage: complete linked medication-administration capture across the prespecified pre-ICU lookback and ICU hours 0-24
per-stay coverage receipts for ED, operating-room, ward, and ICU medication sources
time-resolved evidence that distinguishes treatment initiation, prevalent use, and verified non-use

reportability_rule: With the selected MIMIC-IV inputevents-derived ICU capture, report the structured H2_VERIFIED_NON_USE_UNAVAILABLE feasibility result and do not emit a control arm or treatment-effect estimate. A future causal contrast requires a separately reviewed per-stay source/coverage contract spanning prespecified pre-ICU and ICU medication history and distinguishing initiators, prevalent users, and verified non-users.
